SELECT o."Id", o."CreatedAt", o."Status"
FROM "Orders" AS o
WHERE o."Id" = @__id_0
LIMIT 1

SELECT o."Id", o."CreatedAt", o."Status"
FROM "Orders" AS o
WHERE o."Status" = @__status_0

SELECT o."Id", o."CreatedAt", o."Status", o0."Id", o0."Description", o0."OrderId", o0."ProductName", o0."Quantity"
FROM "Orders" AS o
LEFT JOIN "OrderItems" AS o0 ON o."Id" = o0."OrderId"
ORDER BY o."Id"
